reviewed: All three presentation/tick paths reserve before fitting, refresh/consume before publishing hit coordinates, and cancel reservation after consumption; callback error exits and final cleanup cancels outstanding reservation.

fit_ui does not change unchanged viewports; a real change fences old pointer receipts before resize, preserves focused text receipts through existing independent tokens and invalidates the replacement pointer token before delivery.
Suspended refresh remains separate from native tick/audio resume. Surface timeout preserves existing retry semantics; fit uses reserved dimensions rather than a later window-size read.

Logical viewport uses the same current scale division as pointer coordinates; invalid and unsupported dimensions refuse rather than silently clamp. Resource report reads committed UI state/counters only.
limits: Read-only source review; did not run root tests or open native/GPU window.
New CPU test covers exact logical scale/range; actual resize, composition, hit coordinates and candidate caret placement require combined native acceptance.
Frame dimensions are the existing surface reservation metadata configured by SurfaceState; this review does not assert an independent driver texture-size measurement.
